verdicts.rationale: The scroll API behavior observed is correct and matches the Qdrant contract. The API returns 25 points matching the filter category_id=cat_a out of 50 total points, with next_page_offset=null indicating all results have been returned in this page. The limit parameter (100) is properly respected - the API returns all 25 matching results in one page because 25 < 100. This is standard pagination semantics: when the number of results is less than the limit, all results are returned and pagination terminates. The keyword index is correctly used for filtering, as evidenced by the accurate filter results. This appears to be a misunderstanding of pagination semantics rather than a defect.
